_comment: Which upstream commands have an equivalent here, and which actions stand on their own. Every command carries exactly one of 'gap' or 'action', and an 'action' may add 'partial' when it covers only some of what the upstream command does. Actions with no upstream counterpart belong in 'standalone' rather than being mapped to a loose match. scripts/inventory.py fails when upstream adds a command missing here; scripts/test-sw-action.py fails when an action named here does not exist, when an action is neither mapped nor standalone, or when the README counts disagree.

shopware.createSnippetFromSelection.gap: worth adding; needs the selection plus a snippet-file picker

shopware.insertSnippet.gap: worth adding; needs a picker over existing snippets

shopware.symfony.browseDoctrineEntities.gap: no browser yet; useful for Symfony projects using Doctrine

shopware.symfony.runConsoleCommandPicker.gap: a task runs bin/console directly; only the picker is missing

shopwareLSP.configure.partial: configure is an interactive editor that writes feature toggles and picks a scope; config only prints the effective configuration

shopwareLSP.restart.gap: Zed's own `language server: restart` covers it

shopware.admin.extendComponent.gap: picker-then-insert over Vue components, no equivalent yet

shopware.admin.overrideMethod.gap: picker-then-insert over Vue components, no equivalent yet
